title:
Cooking support! 

Support work promoting cooking skills can involve teaching practical techniques, fostering a positive relationship with food, and building confidence in the kitchen. This can be achieved through various methods, including structured cooking courses, one-on-one guidance, and utilising online resources. 

The goal is to equip individuals with the knowledge and skills to prepare healthy, enjoyable meals, which can positively impact their overall well-being and social connections. 

Well done M, it looks delicious 😋
